name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus Richter's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father in their small village near Spielberg. He pursued an apprenticeship as a metalworker, honing his skills in precision welding and fabrication. His big break came when Anderson Racing, impressed by his meticulous work on a vintage race car restoration project, offered him a position in their fabrication department. 

Klaus approaches his work with a relentless pursuit of perfection. He's known for his ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues and devise innovative solutions. While he may not always be the loudest voice in the room, his quiet dedication and unwavering commitment to quality make him an invaluable asset to the team. He dreams of designing a revolutionary suspension system that will give Anderson Racing a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Klaus is of average height, with a wiry build honed from years of working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting a new task.
Meticulously cleans his tools after every use, regardless of how busy he is.
Has a small collection of vintage spark plugs on his workbench.
